info.title: XXC-APTD management
info.description: Unix socket: filesystem administrator authority. Administrative HTTP: local session, RBAC, exact Origin and CSRF for mutations. Public HTTP never serves these endpoints. Scoped project bearer tokens authorize only explicit publishing routes and suites. /admin is an equivalent private TCP API prefix.

SessionCookie.name: __Host-xxc-session
SessionCookie.description: Admin HTTP interface only. When admin.external_url uses HTTPS, the cookie is __Host-xxc-session with Secure. Explicit HTTP administration uses xxc-session, independently of the public origin or proxy headers. Socket requests authenticate through filesystem permissions.
